tool_args.rationale: The slow-horizon observations show positive short-horizon gain followed by negative response at the target horizon, matching the recalled dual-exponential adaptation law. Fit its four parameters numerically and test fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observed s_grad values are zero, so the sink dependence cannot be identified; the simpler recalled dual-horizon mechanism directly explains the observed reversal.
The observations show a smooth slow reversal consistent with adaptation, rather than evidence of a periodic cycle.
The existing eight observations span both short and target horizons and are sufficient to fit the four-parameter candidate before fresh confirmation.
